High-Flow Spray · Storage Protection

Large K-Factor & ESFR Sprinklers

Two related but distinct product groups: large K-factor spray sprinklers for higher discharge capacity, and fusible-link ESFR sprinklers for storage-protection applications. Each group is identified separately for accurate sourcing.

K11.2 / K161K14.0 / K202ESFR K14.0–K25.212 bar / 175 psiOEM / ODM
Ask on WhatsAppView available models

Large K-factor does not by itself define an ESFR sprinkler. ESFR project suitability, hydraulic design and installation criteria remain subject to the exact product technical data.

Product presentation

Spray and ESFR configurations.

The gallery separates chrome-plated large K-factor glass-bulb sprinklers from natural-copper ESFR fusible-link sprinklers. Similar-looking ESFR models are presented as series views unless the exact K-factor is visible or otherwise confirmed.

Technical overview

Two product groups, clearly separated.

International K-factor values are paired with the metric values used in factory records. Pricing and domestic quotation-sheet language are omitted.

ESFR Storage Sprinklers
